title: Recording: All Things Must Pass by George Harrison | 1970
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: George Harrison, Phil Spector
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Richard Lush

Thursday 30 July 1970 was the 25th recording session for George Harrison’s third solo album All Things Must Pass.

The backing tracks were finished on 25 July. During the end of the month and beginning of August 1970, Harrison worked on overdub sessions at Abbey Road.

Harrison worked with arranger John Barham on a range of overdubs from 28 July until 12 August, although the precise recording details for each day are not known. He worked a four-day week throughout the album recording sessions, with breaks from Saturday to Monday.

Page last updated: 10 April 2025
